nodes.label: Fatty acid solvent extraction from palm oil using liquid-liquid film contactor
nodes.author: Narváez Rincón Paulo Cesar; Noriega Valencia Mario Andrés; L. A. Figueroa

nodes.label: Ethanol FFA extraction in a liquid-liquid film contactor (<80 C), 4 to 0.08 wt.% FFA
nodes.rationale: Solvent extraction at low temperature is proposed as an alternative to steam distillation (deodorization), whose high temperature forms toxic glycidol esters and 3-MCPD and destroys natural phytonutrients.
